# mt2.content.register

Register static scenery resources at startup.

Introduced in Lua API **1.0.0**.

```lua
mt2.content.register(definitions: MT2ContentDefinition[]): MT2ContentReceipt
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `definitions` | `MT2ContentDefinition[]` | `Required` | Nonempty mod-namespaced content definitions. |

## Contract

- **Returns:** MT2ContentReceipt
- **Thread:** Framework callbacks; native object/camera/time reads verify the game thread.
- **When to call:** Script preparation/start only, before a world is loaded.
- **Effects:** Stages definitions then mounts their assets on activation. Content changes require restart.
- **Reload:** Subscriptions owned by the old instance are removed on a successful replacement.
- **Persistence:** Save metadata records required content package versions and hashes.
- **Capabilities:** `content`
- **Since:** 1.0.0
- **Stability:** stable-within-api-1

## Errors

- Duplicate IDs/resources, foreign namespaces, missing model/material files and late registration are rejected.

## Example

This complete example is also available under `examples/content/main.lua` in the source and SDK documentation bundle. Native effects require the real game.

```lua
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
mt2.content.register({{id="example.content:pyramid",name="Pyramid",variant="mt2fw_example_content_266054d085dd_pyramid",model="assets/mt2fw/example_content_266054d085dd_pyramid/model.vmb",material="assets/materials/mt2fw_example_content_266054d085dd_pyramid_0.mat"}})
```
